units.source_text: 诚然，吾八在这家旅馆工作了八年，都快五十岁了。

en.t: Indeed, Gohachi had worked at this inn for eight years and was already nearly fifty years old.

units.source_text: 前半辈子，他凭着一把菜刀走遍了沿海各城镇。

en.t: In the first half of his life, he had wandered through the towns along the coast with only a kitchen knife to rely on.

units.source_text: 这期间，他切掉了左手中指的指甲，似乎娶过两三回老婆。

en.t: During that time, he had cut off the nail of the middle finger on his left hand, and it seems he had married two or three times.

units.source_text: 说“似乎”，是因为这个温泉浴场使他全然忘却了过去。

en.t: I say "it seems" because this hot spring bathhouse had made him forget the past completely.

units.source_text: 就是说，在这里的时候，他从不提起往事。

en.t: That is to say, while he was here, he never spoke of the old days.

units.source_text: 他不是要隐瞒过去，只是完全失去了回忆往事的兴趣。

en.t: He was not trying to hide his past; he had simply lost all interest in remembering it.
